sections.title: Where to Find the Lumiere Citizen
How to Beat the Lumiere Citizen
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Physical (mage form) is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It resists Fire and Lightning (rapiers), Ice and Earth (gun or sword), so that damage is halved.
